title: Our Fictional Services
subtitle: Discover how we can help you become space enthusiasts.

service1.title: Alien Life Discovery
service1.description: Hunt for E.T. with radio telescopes and AI! Scan stars for alien signals, name any we find, and join our “First Contact Party” if we spot space microbes or chatty extraterrestrials.

service2.title: Starship Joyride Simulator
service2.description: Pilot a virtual spaceship in VR! Dodge asteroids, zip past Saturn’s rings, or race comets using NASA data. Get a custom flight patch and brag about your cosmic adventure.

service3.title: Name-Your-Own Star
service3.description: Name a star after yourself or your pet! Get a star map and throw a telescope party with cosmic snacks and music. Immortalize your name in the sky!

service4.title: Meteorite Treasure Hunt
service4.description: Hunt meteorites with a detector and our app! Find space rocks, name them (like “StarSmasher”), and get a certified cosmic keepsake. It’s an epic adventure for starry-eyed explorers.

service5.title: Galactic Pen Pal Program
service5.description: Send messages to aliens via radio transmitter! Write to distant stars, get a “Cosmic Postmark,” and await a reply from Proxima Centauri. Start an intergalactic chat today!

service6.title: Zero-Gravity Dance Party
service6.description: Dance in a microgravity chamber to space tunes! Float, spin, and moonwalk like an astronaut. Record your moves for a stellar vid. Gravity’s out, fun’s in!
